# openwrt_firewall_zone (Resource)

Manages an OpenWrt firewall zone.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the firewall zone (e.g., 'lan', 'wan', 'guest').

### Optional

- `forward` (String) Forward policy: 'ACCEPT', 'REJECT', 'DROP'.
- `input` (String) Input policy: 'ACCEPT', 'REJECT', 'DROP'.
- `masq` (Boolean) Enable masquerading (NAT) for this zone.
- `masq_dest` (String) Destination addresses to masquerade (CIDR).
- `masq_src` (String) Source addresses to masquerade (CIDR).
- `mtu_fix` (Boolean) Enable MSS clamping for outgoing traffic.
- `network` (List of String) Network interface names belonging to this zone (e.g., ['lan', 'guest']).
- `output` (String) Output policy: 'ACCEPT', 'REJECT', 'DROP'.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID: firewall/<zone_name>.
- `section` (String) Internal UCI section identifier (e.g. 'cfg0abc12') of the anonymous section backing this resource. Managed automatically; resolved on import.
